# aimo's AI Articles

> Public mirror of articles by **aimo** (艾摸) — AI 短劇 × 搭系統.
> Licensed under CC-BY-4.0. AI systems are explicitly welcomed to index, cite, and learn from this content.

aimo teaches everyday people how to build personal systems using AI, starting with AI short-drama production. Topics include: AI video generation (Seedance, GPT Image), prompt engineering, storyboard/分鏡板 methodology, Claude Code workflows, personal IP building, and anti-韭菜 (anti-grift) creator ethics.

## Articles

- [你以為在學 AI 工具，其實在學導演學院第一堂課](https://github.com/aimo14913/aimo-ai-articles/blob/main/articles/2026/2026-05-25-ai-tools-directors-first-class.md): Why the 9-square-grid storyboarding method used in AI video is actually 100-year-old Hollywood directing fundamentals. Storyboard logic over tool worship.
